entities.summary: The Fellini Museum is a museum in Rimini, Italy, dedicated to Rimini-born film director Federico Fellini. It comprises three locations in Rimini's historic town center: the interior of the Castel Sismondo, a medieval castle; the Fulgor Palace, which houses a cinema; and Piazza Malatesta, the square located outside the castle. The museum was inaugurated on 19 August 2021.
